rows.grounds: adjective modifying implied object; opposed sense
compound veda+vāda; locative of debate context
gerundive of śru; obligation to hear

items.question: Should contradictory statements in Vedic debate still be heard without doubt here?
premises: Contradictory Vedic statements are to be heard.
No doubt exists in this context.
items.inference: The verse affirms hearing even contradictory Vedic statements here without doubt.
uncertainties: The exact scope of viruddham may be broader than a single opposed statement.
vedavāde may mean either in Vedic debate or according to Vedic discussion.
items.plain_english: Even contradictory statements in Vedic debate should be heard; there is no doubt about this here.
